ticket_id: CW-18/CW-06 smoke-03 O1: tmux-wrapped OMP notification shown as text

routing.selected_role: worker_senior (Opus, reused cd68-terminal2 per user request)

problem: When Workbench runs inside tmux (+Warp), the manager OMP pane showed OMP's notification as literal text: `tmux;]777;notify;warp://…` including the user's input and the reply text. OMP sees TMUX in its environment and wraps OSC 777 notifications in a tmux DCS passthrough (ESC P tmux; ESC ESC ] 777;notify;… BEL ESC \); the Workbench pane VT path renders it as text.

The Workbench must still work inside the user's tmux/herdr (ADR-0001) and keep the existing outer-tmux/OSC 52 copy behaviour (model.py uses TMUX for copy). Prefer consuming/ignoring these sequences in the pane VT path; changing the OMP pane environment is acceptable only if it does not change the host shell environment or OMP features the user relies on — explain the choice.
Do not forward notifications to the outer terminal in this unit (just never render them as text).

Reproduce first with a real OMP 18.6.1 notification-like byte stream (no model call: feed captured bytes or run a tiny program inside a pane that prints the exact sequence), then red->green tests (unit + one PTY-level test).
